provider.transport: DeepSeekModelProvider: one chat completion per request, response_format json_object, thinking disabled, stream false, no provider retry or fallback

attemptPolicy.resume: Only samples that have no invocation record may start; a sample that ever started is never started again in the same batch.

execution.isolation: One Maven/JVM process, one fresh PostgreSQL 17.6 container and one private runtime root per sample

metering.actualTokens: Provider-reported prompt_tokens/completion_tokens only; a call is KNOWN only when both are present.
metering.unknown: A finished call with any missing count is UNKNOWN; exact totals are null unless every call is KNOWN.
metering.cache: Provider cache-hit tokens are part of prompt_tokens and are never added a second time.
metering.charged: Runtime budget charges (conservative reservations) are reported separately and never as actual usage.
